setting.help: Send documents to the EasyOCR service for scans and photos that carry no text layer of their own.
Base address of the EasyOCR service. The /api/v1/ocr/file endpoint is added automatically.
Key the service expects in the X-API-Key header.
How long to wait for the service before giving up, in seconds. A scanned page can take a while to read, so keep this generous.

setting.string: Tell the service who we are
setting.help: Add our own name and tax number to the request, so the service can tell the two parties apart on the document.
Post the supplier bill as soon as it is created, instead of leaving it in draft for review. Off by default: posting books the bill and gives it a number.

setting.string: Create products that do not exist
setting.help: When a line carries a supplier reference no product matches, create the product instead of leaving the line without one.

setting.string: Accept our own company as vendor
setting.help: Book a document whose tax number is ours. Off by default: it is almost always a document that was read the wrong way round.

setting.string: Ask before reading a document already read
setting.help: Before sending a file to the service, look for a document with the same content that has already been read, and ask. Reading it again costs a reading; leaving the question alone costs nothing.
How far back that check looks. 0 means no limit. Useful for a vendor whose monthly document is exactly the same file every month.

Where a receipt photographed from a phone ends up. A supplier bill needs a vendor; a ticket from a petrol station is not one, so the employee expense is usually the better fit when the person taking the photo is the one who paid.

setting.string: Let the phone send the expense
setting.help: Let whoever took the photo put the expense forward for approval at the same time, instead of leaving it in draft until they open Odoo.

setting.string: Create the bill from a webhook
setting.help: When the service says it has finished reading a document, make the supplier bill from it without waiting for anyone. Off by default: a webhook is a message from outside, and a bill is an accounting entry.
Register the payment on the bills a webhook creates, as if the money had already gone out. It only applies to a bill that is confirmed, because a bill in draft has nothing to pay against.
Where the payment of a webhook bill is recorded.
How the payment is recorded on that bank account. Left empty, Odoo takes the one the account has by default.
